name: Nightmare Harem
source:
It was just one of those days, that everything had to go wrong. 
Work was exhausting, relationship was failing,…

But then, on the way back home, something extraordinary happens. Through the shadows of Red Moon, you came to a mystic land called the Kingdom of Nightmare, ruled by angels and demons.

And soon after, you discover that you are here to find your destiny, to find where you truly belong…your one true love.


[from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/143798626296/mymysticromance]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
那是所有事情都出错的一天。工作令人疲惫，感情也在失败……

但回家路上，非凡之事发生了。穿过红月的阴影，你来到神秘国度噩梦王国，那里由天使与恶魔统治。

不久后，你发现自己来到这里是为了寻找命运，找到真正属于自己的地方……找到唯一真爱。

[来源：[url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/143798626296/mymysticromance]English Otome Games[/url]]
